raw: {"analysis": "Response LGQ provides a comprehensive plan with parallel lanes and a detailed landing strategy, but it includes running benchmarks on every push (costly) and schedules production deployment on Friday, which is beyond the stated requirement of staging by Friday. Response JNV is more focused, with a single integration lane, explicit cost control, and only goes to staging, aligning with the deadline. Both correctly address the flaky test, architect approval, and performance gates, but JNV is more efficient and avoids unnecessary steps.", "verdict": "JNV"}
